items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) is out for a second straight week; Tyler Huntley starts. Model now uses Huntley (nflverse still listed Jackson).

Baltimore is also without C Cam Jurgens and DT Broderick Washington. Cleveland is without DTs Mike Hall Jr. and Kalia Davis, G Teven Jenkins and RB Dylan Sampson; RB Quinshon Judkins and DT Mason Graham are questionable.
